id: 07_Study of Open Circuit and Short Circuit Conditions in an AC Circuit Basic Electr
title: 交流电路的开路与短路状态
source_doc: course/Basic Electrical Engineering Lab/07_Study of Open Circuit and Short Circuit Conditions in an AC Circuit Basic Electr.md
author_source: project/Basic Electrical Engineering Lab/07_Study of Open Circuit and Short Circuit Conditions in an AC Circuit Basic Electr/src.py

points.K6: 电流表和开关组成短路支路
points.K7: 电压表并在灯 1 两端

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验台旁，台上两盏灯泡、一只电流表、一只电压表，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a lab bench with two light bulbs on a wiring board, an analog ammeter and an analog voltmeter, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课做交流电路的开路与短路实验。
overlay: 交流电路的开路与短路

shots.scene: 断开的电路和被短接的电路两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a circuit with a gap, and a circuit with a wire bridging across a lamp. No people.
shots.narration: 开路和短路，到底有什么不同？

shots.scene: 阿杰翻着空白课本，指着开路和短路两个词发愁
shots.prompt_en: The young male student flips through a blank textbook, frowning at two circuit icons: an open gap and a bridged load.
shots.narration: 阿杰总分不清开路和短路。

shots.scene: 小研指向实验台上的两盏灯和两只表
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points to two lamps and two meters on the lab bench.
shots.narration: 小研说：做一遍实验，看看表就明白。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 一起来研究开路和短路的影响。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着开路、短路两个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the open circuit icon and the short circuit icon.
shots.narration: 目的：观察开路和短路时电压电流的变化。

shots.scene: 实验台上：交流电流表、交流电压表、两盏白炽灯、一个单极开关
shots.prompt_en: On the bench: an AC ammeter, an AC voltmeter, two incandescent bulbs and a single-pole switch. No people.
shots.narration: 器材：交流电流表、电压表，都是动铁式。

shots.scene: 两盏灯泡旁空白铭牌
shots.prompt_en: Two incandescent bulbs with blank nameplates beside them. No people.
shots.narration: 白炽灯两只，一百瓦、二百三十伏。

shots.scene: 电压表旁边一只万用表打问号
shots.prompt_en: A voltmeter next to a multimeter with a small question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 没有电压表，可以用万用表代替。

shots.scene: 接线板上的电源区：一个双极开关和一个熔断器
shots.prompt_en: The supply section of a patch board: a double-pole switch and a fuse. No people.
shots.narration: 单相交流电，二百三十伏、五十赫兹。

shots.scene: 相线和中性线从熔断器和开关后引出到插孔
shots.prompt_en: Live and neutral lines lead out from the fuse and switch to two sockets on the board. No people.
shots.narration: 经双极开关和五安熔断器引出相线、中性线。

shots.scene: 两端带插头的连接导线打绿勾，两根裸线头打红叉
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a connecting lead with proper plugs on both ends with a green check, and two bare wire ends crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 连接导线要带合适的插头，不用裸线头。

shots.scene: 电路图：相线接灯 1，灯 1 接灯 2，灯 2 接中性线
shots.prompt_en: A circuit diagram icon: the line wire goes to lamp one, lamp one to lamp two, and lamp two to the neutral wire. No people.
shots.narration: 相线接灯一，灯一接灯二，灯二接零线。

shots.scene: 两盏灯首尾相连成一串
shots.prompt_en: Two lamp icons connected end to end in a single series loop. No people.
shots.narration: 两盏灯串联，构成主回路。

shots.section_title: 电流表和开关组成短路支路
shots.scene: 从灯 1 前端引线到电流表，再到开关，回到灯 1 后端
shots.prompt_en: The diagram highlights a branch: from the front of lamp one through an ammeter and a switch back to the back of lamp one. No people.
shots.narration: 电流表和开关串起来，跨接在灯一两端。
overlay: 电流表和开关组成短路支路

shots.section_title: 电流表和开关组成短路支路
shots.scene: 支路导线画得比主回路粗
shots.prompt_en: The branch wire drawn thicker than the main loop wires. No people.
shots.narration: 这条支路用粗一点的导线。

shots.section_title: 电流表和开关组成短路支路
shots.scene: 开关后端接到灯 1 后端或灯 2 前端，两点用同色圆点标出
shots.prompt_en: The diagram marks the back of lamp one and the front of lamp two with the same colored dot. No people.
shots.narration: 接灯一后端或灯二前端，都是同一点。

shots.section_title: 电压表并在灯 1 两端
shots.scene: 电压表用细导线并接在灯 1 两端
shots.prompt_en: A voltmeter connected with thin wires across lamp one. No people.
shots.narration: 电压表用细线，并在灯一两端。
overlay: 电压表并在灯 1 两端

shots.section_title: 电压表并在灯 1 两端
shots.scene: 电压表和电流表的量程旋钮各指向一个挡
shots.prompt_en: Range terminals on the voltmeter and ammeter highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 电压表选三百伏，电流表选一安或两安。

shots.scene: 先画出串联回路，再加上并联支路的两步图
shots.prompt_en: Two step icons: first the series loop drawn, then the parallel branch added. No people.
shots.narration: 接线顺序：先接串联，后接并联。

shots.scene: 接线板上两盏灯、开关、两只表的实物
shots.prompt_en: The real setup on the bench: two bulbs, a switch, an ammeter and a voltmeter connected with plug leads. No people.
shots.narration: 实物就是这样：两盏灯，一开关，两只表。

shots.scene: 开关 S1 处于断开位置，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A close-up of switch S1 in the off position with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 通电时，开关 S1 必须先断开。

shots.scene: 电压表接线柱被圈出，箭头指向下刻度
shots.prompt_en: The voltmeter's connected terminal circled, an arrow pointing to the lower scale on the dial. No people.
shots.narration: 先看表接在哪个量程，读对应刻度。

shots.scene: 表盘一段放大，数小格
shots.prompt_en: A magnified section of the dial showing small divisions between two numbered marks. No people.
shots.narration: 再数小格，算出读数。

shots.scene: S1 断开，灯 1 发亮
shots.prompt_en: Switch S1 open; lamp one glows. No people.
shots.narration: S1 断开，这就是开路状态，灯一亮着。

shots.scene: 电压表指针偏转较大
shots.prompt_en: The voltmeter needle deflects well up the scale. No people.
shots.narration: 电压表读数约一百一十二到一百一十四伏。

shots.scene: 电流表指针停在零
shots.prompt_en: The ammeter needle stays at zero. No people.
shots.narration: 电流表读数为零。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着开路卡片：电压高，电流零
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a card with an open circuit icon.
shots.narration: 开路：电压高，电流为零。

shots.scene: 老周戴着腕表，徒手扳下开关 S1，灯 1 熄灭
shots.prompt_en: The older man, wearing a metal wristwatch, flips switch S1 on the patch board bare-handed; lamp one goes dark.
shots.narration: 闭合 S1，灯一被短接，熄灭了。

shots.scene: 电流表指针偏转
shots.prompt_en: The ammeter needle deflects. No people.
shots.narration: 电流表读数约零点四一到零点四二安。

shots.scene: 电压表指针回到零
shots.prompt_en: The voltmeter needle drops back to zero. No people.
shots.narration: 灯一两端电压变成零。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着短路卡片：电流大，电压零
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a card with a short circuit icon.
shots.narration: 短路：电流大，电压为零。

shots.scene: 王老师拿着三张空白问题卡
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator holds three blank question cards.
shots.narration: 口试常问三个问题。

shots.scene: 开路和短路两个图标之间一个问号
shots.prompt_en: An open circuit icon and a short circuit icon with a question mark between them. No people.
shots.narration: 一问：开路和短路有什么区别？

shots.scene: 两盏灯，其中一盏变暗，旁边问号
shots.prompt_en: Two lamps, one dimmer than the other, with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 二问：短路时，为什么一盏灯变暗？

shots.scene: 动铁式和动圈式表芯剖面
shots.prompt_en: Cutaway icons of a moving iron and a moving coil meter movement. No people.
shots.narration: 三问：动铁式和动圈式仪表有何不同？

shots.scene: 空白结果表，只有开关、亮灯、灭灯图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank results table with only switch icons and lamp-on and lamp-off icons in the cells. No people.
shots.narration: 把开关状态、电压、电流、灯的状态填进表。

shots.scene: 开路和短路两张卡片并排
shots.prompt_en: The open circuit card and the short circuit card side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 开路电压大电流零，短路电流大电压零。

shots.scene: 开路和短路两张卡片
shots.prompt_en: Two cards: an open circuit icon and a short circuit icon. No people.
shots.narration: 开路电压大电流零，短路电流大电压零。

shots.scene: 串联主回路和并联支路的接线顺序图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons showing the wiring order: series main loop first, then the parallel branch. No people.
shots.narration: 带插头导线，先串后并，S1 先断开。

shots.scene: 表盘上下两条刻度和一个放大镜
shots.prompt_en: A meter dial with upper and lower scales and a magnifying glass. No people.
shots.narration: 看清量程再读数，记好结果表。

shots.scene: 欣欣在实验台前挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye in front of a lab bench with two lamps and two meters.
shots.narration: 分清开路和短路，下次见！
